verdicts.explanation: The Introduction states that Inaguma et al.'s first report of LLTO gave a bulk conductivity of 1.0 × 10-3 S/cm at room temperature, cited as ref 11, so the value, kind, cited origin and null temperature are all correct.
The paper gives an apparent grain-boundary conductivity of 7.5 × 10-5 S/cm for LLTO at room temperature, attributed to the Inaguma report (ref 11), which matches the record.
The Introduction gives σb = 3.5 × 10-4 S/cm at room temperature for LSTZ0.75 from ref 16, and Zr is the B-site substituent (y = 0.75 in the general formula), so the record is correct.
The paper reports an apparent σgb of 1.2 × 10-3 S/cm for LSTZ0.75 at room temperature (ref 16), including the grain size effect, which matches the record's grain_boundary kind.
The paper reports a total conductivity σt of 2.7 × 10-4 S/cm for LSTZ0.75 at room temperature (ref 16), which matches the record's total kind.

Section 2.1 gives the highest experimental σb of 4.1 × 10-4 S/cm at 25 ℃ and Ea of 0.33 eV from 25 to 140 ℃ for a hot-pressed LSTZ0.75 sample from ref 37, so the value, temperature, Ea, synthesis method and literature origin are all supported.
